question_cn: 外通路兵（远离对方兵群的通路兵）的战略价值是：
question_en: Outside passed pawn (passed pawn far from the enemy pawn cluster) — its strategic value is:

options.text_cn: 迫使对方王长途跋涉去拦截，己方王趁机吃掉对方兵群
options.text_en: Force enemy king on a long march to intercept it, own king captures the enemy pawn cluster

options.text_cn: 外通路兵比内通路兵更弱，不重要
options.text_en: Outside passed pawn is weaker than inside, not important

options.text_cn: 外通路兵需要己方王护送才有价值
options.text_en: Outside passed pawn only has value with king escort

options.text_cn: 把外通路兵推到第7排再说
options.text_en: Push the outside passer to the 7th rank and then decide

explanation_cn: 外通路兵是兵残局最强的战略武器：对方王必须去追，己方王就能横扫另一侧的兵群。这是"牵制 + 突破"组合的最高形式，兵残局教学中的重要里程碑。
explanation_en: Outside passed pawn is the most powerful strategic weapon: enemy king must chase it, freeing own king to devour the pawn cluster. The 'tying down + breakthrough' combination at its best.
